simple.meaning: מָשָׁל (mâshâl) appears 39 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship and in connection with prophetic witness.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 9 more, beginning at Numbers 23:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship, prophetic witness, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָשָׁל (H4912) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מָשָׁל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H4912. mashal II. מָשָׁל noun masculine Isa 14:4 proverb, parable (of sentences constructed in parallelism , usually of Hebrew Wisdom, but occasionally of other types); — absolute ׳מ Ezek 17:2 20 t.; construct מְשַׁל 1Sam 24:14 ; suffix מְשָׁלוֺ Num 23:7-8 t.; plural מְשָׁלִים Eccl 12:9 2 t.; construct מִשְׁלֵי Prov 1:1 3 t.; — 1 proverbial saying , brief terse sentence of popular sagacity 1Sam 10:12 ; Ezek 12:22-23 , 18:2-3 , ׳מ הַקַדְמֹנִי 1Sam 24:14 proverb of the ancients. 2 by-word Psa 44:15 ; 69:12 ; וְלִשְׁנִינָה לְמָשָׁל Deut 28:37 ; 1Kin 9:7 ; 2Chr 7:20 ; Jer 24:9 ; וּלְמָשָׁל לְאוֺת Ezek 14:8 3 prophetic figurative discourse: מָשָׁל נָשָׂא lift up, utter a ׳מ Num 23:7 , 18 ; 24:3 , 15 , 20 , 21 , 23 (all of Balaam); Isa 14:4 ; Micah 2:4 (|| נהי ) Hab 2:6 (|| חידה ), (compare Job 27:1 ; 29:1 for same phrase under 6 ). 4 similitude, parable , Ezek 17:2 ; 21:5 ; 24:3 . 5 poem , of various kinds: the ode ( Num 21:27-30 ), the 3, 000 pieces traditionally ascribed to Solomon 1Kin 5:12 , didactic psalms Psa 49:5 ; 78:2 . 6 sentences of ethical wisdom חֲכָמִים דִּבְרֵי collected in the שְׁלֹמֹה מִשְׁלֵי Prov 10:1 ; 25:1 ( 10:1-22 :16 consisting of 376 couplets chiefly antithetical; Proverbs 25-29 chiefly couplets of an emblematic type, but also occasional tristichs, tetrastichs, pentastichs, and decastichs. To these are appended דְּבָרִים of a more mixed character as to size and content 22:7-24 :22, 23-34; 30:1-14 ; 30:15-33 ; 31:1-9 ; 31:10-31 ; the Praise of Wisdom 1:8-9 is prefixed, and an introduction to the whole 1:1-7 , in which the whole contents are represented as) משׁלים 1:1 , compare 1:6 . The references in Job 13:12 ; 27:1 ; 29:1 ; Prov 26:7 , 9 ; Eccl 12:9 are to the same type of wisdom.
